task_message:
Case L02: segment the lipomatous soft-tissue tumor on this T1-weighted MRI.

Volume: 251x251x477 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
The case is complete. 

**Summary of what was done:**
- **Finding the lesion:** Scanned the volume with axial/coronal/sagittal contact sheets. Identified a large hyperintense (fat-signal) mass in the limb — a well-circumscribed lipomatous tumor tapering over ~95 mm, with displaced muscle around it and a heterogeneous (less fatty) nodular component inside.
- **Initial mask:** Point prompts on the fatty mass (marks 210/164) at the slice where it is largest (axial 84) → coherent 91.6 mL single-component mask.
- **Verification/correction:** Checked the boundary at high zoom on axial (78, 92), coronal (130, 140) and sagittal (105/110) planes; ran a model refine (v2, 89.5 mL) that slightly tightened the border without changing extent. Verified the volume edge at axial 0 and the tapering superior pole near the joint line.
- **Candidate review:** C1–C3 were proposals of normal subcutaneous fat (rejected); C4 was a 0.7 mL unrelated fat speck in muscle (rejected).
- **Final mask:** v2, 89.5 mL, 1 component, extent axial 0–95, coronal 96–164, sagittal 78–135, saved with **medium** confidence (boundary well supported in all three planes; slight uncertainty only at the thin superior pole and the volume-truncated inferior tip).
